component-o.description-s: High-performance MCU with RISC-V 32-bit dual-core processor up to 360 MHz and single-core low-power processor up to 40 MHz, 768 KB HP L2MEM, 32 KB LP SRAM, 16 MB or 32 MB in-package PSRAM, powerful image and voice processing capability including ISP, H264 encoder, JPEG codec, MIPI CSI/DSI, 55 programmable GPIOs, rich set of peripherals including USB 2.0 HS OTG, Ethernet MAC, SDIO, multiple UARTs, SPIs, I2Cs, I2Ss, operating temperature –40 to 85 °C
